description: Order and Ranking is a crucial part of Logical Reasoning. It involves determining the positions of individuals or objects in a Left-Right or Top-Bottom sequence based on given data.

sections.title: Basic Concepts
sections.description: Understanding the directions and ends is essential to accurately determine the position of individuals in a row or queue.

key_concepts.explanation: In a horizontal arrangement, 'Left' indicates the start of the row, and 'Right' indicates the end of the row.
In a vertical arrangement, 'Top' is considered the starting point, and 'Bottom' is considered the ending point.

sections.title: Finding Total Number of Persons
sections.description: When the rank of the exact same person is provided from both ends of the sequence, the total number of people can be calculated.

steps.title: Identify Ranks
steps.detail: Ensure that the two positions (ranks) provided belong to the exact same person or object.

steps.title: Add Ranks
steps.detail: Sum the positional values from both ends (Left + Right or Top + Bottom).

steps.title: Subtract 1
steps.detail: Subtract 1 from the total sum because the specific person has been counted twice (once from each end).

sections.title: Swapping of Positions
sections.description: When two individuals interchange their positions in a row, a specific logical approach is required to find the new rank or total number.

steps.title: Select New Rank
steps.detail: After the swap, identify the person whose new updated rank is given in the problem.

steps.title: Take Old Rank
steps.detail: Take the old rank of the other person, because the first person is now occupying that exact seat.

steps.title: Apply Formula
steps.detail: Total = (New Rank of first person) + (Old Rank of second person) - 1.

sections.title: Number of Persons Between Two Persons
sections.description: When the positions of two different individuals are given, there are two major scenarios to find the number of people sitting strictly between them.

results: The individuals do not cross each other in the arrangement.
Persons Between = Total - (Left Rank + Right Rank)
The individuals cross each other's positions.
Persons Between = (Left Rank + Right Rank) - Total - 2

sections.title: Maximum and Minimum Persons
sections.description: When the total number of people is unknown but the ranks and the number of middle persons are given, we calculate the boundary limits.

equations: Maximum Total = Left Rank + Right Rank + Persons Between
Minimum Total = Left Rank + Right Rank - Persons Between - 2

results: The Minimum Total (overlapping case) is only possible if: Smaller Rank > (Persons Between + 1).
If this condition fails, an overlapping arrangement cannot be formed with the given data.
